description: Remove Goals and Runs Management - Refactor backend to remove goal/run functionality and repurpose schedules for DAG

userStories.title: Remove Goals Routes
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to remove the goals route file and its registration so that the Goals API is no longer exposed.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove scheduler parameter from route registration

userStories.title: Remove Runs Routes
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to remove the runs route file and its registration so that the Runs API is no longer exposed.

userStories.title: Remove goals and memories tables from schema
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to remove the goals and memories tables from the database schema.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove goals table definition from packages/backend/src/db/schema.ts
Remove memories table definition from schema.ts
Remove Goal, NewGoal, Memory, NewMemory type exports

userStories.title: Remove runs, steps, outputs tables from schema
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to remove the runs, steps, and outputs tables from the database schema.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove runs table definition from packages/backend/src/db/schema.ts
Remove steps table definition from schema.ts
Remove outputs table definition from schema.ts
Remove Run, NewRun, Step, NewStep, Output, NewOutput type exports

userStories.title: Update schedules table to reference DAGs
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to modify the schedules table to support DAG scheduling instead of goal scheduling.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove goalId foreign key from schedules table in schema.ts
Add dagId foreign key referencing dags.id with onDelete cascade
Update schedulesRelations to reference dags instead of goals
Update Schedule type export if needed

userStories.title: Remove AgentOrchestrator
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to remove the AgentOrchestrator class entirely since it's no longer needed.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove any imports of AgentOrchestrator from other files (check cron.ts)

userStories.title: Remove CronScheduler and update server
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to remove CronScheduler and update server.ts to use only DAGScheduler.
acceptanceCriteria: Keep DAGScheduler as the sole scheduler

userStories.title: Clean up shared package goal/run schemas
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to remove goal/run-related schemas and utilities from the shared package.
acceptanceCriteria: Search shared package for createGoalSchema, updateGoalSchema, goalParamsSchema
Remove or deprecate unused goal/run schemas
Remove generateGoalId if no longer used elsewhere
Remove generateRunId if no longer used elsewhere

userStories.title: Update OpenAPI spec - remove goals endpoints
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to remove goals endpoints from the OpenAPI specification.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove Goal-related request/response schemas from openapi.yaml
userStories.notes: Kept a minimal deprecated Goal schema for RunWithGoal reference - will be fully removed in US-010 with runs

userStories.title: Update OpenAPI spec - remove runs endpoints
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to remove runs endpoints from the OpenAPI specification.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove Run-related request/response schemas from openapi.yaml
userStories.notes: Removed all runs endpoints (/api/v1/runs, /api/v1/runs/{id}, /api/v1/runs/{id}/steps) and related schemas (Run, RunWithGoal, Step, RunStatus, RunId, RunStatusQuery, Goal, OutputKind, MemoryType)

userStories.title: Regenerate API clients
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to regenerate the API clients after OpenAPI changes.
acceptanceCriteria: Run pnpm generate to regenerate JS and Python API clients
Verify generated clients match spec with pnpm test:check-generate

userStories.title: Update backend AGENTS.md documentation
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to update the backend AGENTS.md to reflect removed functionality.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove Goals Management section from packages/backend/AGENTS.md
Remove Runs Management section from packages/backend/AGENTS.md
Update Database Schema section to remove goals, runs, steps, memories, outputs tables
Update schedules table documentation to show dagId reference

userStories.title: Update root AGENTS.md documentation
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to update the root AGENTS.md if it references goals/runs.
acceptanceCriteria: Check root AGENTS.md for any references to goals or runs
Remove or update any goal/run references found
Ensure API documentation section reflects current endpoints

userStories.title: Remove goal/run related tests
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to remove tests related to goals and runs.
acceptanceCriteria: Search for and remove any other goal/run related test files
Ensure remaining tests pass: pnpm --filter backend test

userStories.title: Generate and apply database migration
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to generate and apply database migrations for schema changes.
acceptanceCriteria: Run pnpm --filter backend db:generate to generate migration
Run pnpm --filter backend db:push to apply schema changes

userStories.title: Final verification
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to verify the refactoring is complete with no regressions.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend starts successfully: pnpm --filter backend dev
No references to goals, runs, steps, memories, outputs in codebase (except migrations)
